title: Synthesis of Co3Fe7/CoFe2O4 incorporated porous carbon catalysts via molten salt method: applications in the oxygen reduction reaction and 4-nitrophenol reduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10884-10895
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00893J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanling Wu, Xi Tang, Hui He, Qingyuan Luo, Wenkai Fu, Qinggao Hou, Haijun Zhang
Four Fe/Co ratio composite catalysts were synthesized via freeze-drying and in situ calcination. Among them, Co3Fe7/CoFe2O4@NC-1 demonstrated superior 4-NP reduction activity, while Co3Fe7/CoFe2O4@NC-3 exceled in alkaline ORR performance.
